title: ANPD Regulatory Sandbox on Artificial Intelligence and Data Protection
title_original: Sandbox Regulatório em Inteligência Artificial e Proteção de Dados
summary: Pilot regulatory sandbox run by the ANPD in which companies test AI systems in a controlled, supervised environment, with algorithmic transparency under LGPD Article 20 as its focus. The project page dates from October 2023; the ANPD selected the University of São Paulo's AI and Machine Learning Centre (CIAAM/USP) as partner under Call No. 1/2024 and three participants (Metatext, Synapse AI and Prevvine) under Call No. 2/2025. Testing began in March 2026. The ANPD published a testing methodology and three partial monitoring reports by October 2026; a fourth cycle will run the planned tests and feed future ANPD guidance.
beneficiaries: AI developers selected as sandbox participants
